attempted_claim: For every prime p let G_p = C_{p^2} \oplus C_{p^2}. Let Ol(G_p) be the Olson constant: the smallest k such that every subset of G_p of cardinality k contains a nonempty subset summing to zero. Determine the exact integer Ol(G_p) as a function of p and classify the maximal zero-sum-free subsets of size Ol(G_p)-1, controlling the subset-sum incidence variety by an explicit Chevalley--Warning / combinatorial Nullstellenssatz system over F_p. A complete answer proves the exact value for all sufficiently large p and the full extremal-subset description up to automorphism and translation.
